bedprotect.welcome.tagline: Guards you from beds exploding in the Nether/End
bedprotect.welcome.smart: Smart protection, once beds are allowed:
bedprotect.welcome.smart_detail_1: a bed blows up only if the damage is ≤ %s
bedprotect.welcome.smart_detail_2: and at least %s is left after it
bedprotect.welcome.look_detail: under the crosshair you see what a click does
bedprotect.settings.beds: Beds in the Nether and End
bedprotect.screen.title: BedProtect — settings
bedprotect.screen.tip.beds: DENIED — beds that explode cannot be clicked at all. ALLOWED — smart protection decides.
bedprotect.screen.tip.protection: Lets a blast through only if the damage is within the maximum and the reserve remains.
bedprotect.screen.tip.ping: The click is checked first: holding right-click never fires; on servers the mod waits out the ping and uses the lowest recent health.
bedprotect.screen.tip.confirm: On servers a bed blows up only on a second click within 2 seconds.
bedprotect.screen.tip.maxdamage: How many hearts the blast may take.
bedprotect.screen.tip.reserve: How many hearts must remain after the blast.
bedprotect.screen.tip.hud: Coloured text under the crosshair while you look at a bed.
bedprotect.screen.tip.chat: Chat message when entering the Nether or the End.
bedprotect.screen.tip.block_messages: Text above the hotbar when a bed click is blocked.
bedprotect.screen.tip.confirmations: Chat line after a /bedprotect command you typed.
bedprotect.screen.tip.welcome: Show the welcome message in chat again.
bedprotect.help.ping: check the click first: held key and ping
bedprotect.help.confirm: on servers a bed blows up only on the second click
bedprotect.gate.unstable: ⏳ Checking… ping %s ms — click again in a moment
bedprotect.gate.confirm: ⚠ Click again within %s s to blow it up
bedprotect.hud.server_confirm: Server · ping %s ms · blows up on the 2nd click
bedprotect.mode.disabled: Beds that explode cannot be clicked at all
bedprotect.mode.protected: Allowed if damage ≤ %1$s and ≥ %2$s is left
bedprotect.mode.vanilla: No protection: beds explode like in vanilla!
bedprotect.help.protection: smart protection: only safe blasts go through
bedprotect.help.chat: reminder when entering the Nether or the End
bedprotect.help.check: full calculation for the bed you look at
bedprotect.help.maxdamage: most damage a blast may deal (now %1$s)
bedprotect.help.tip: Click a command to put it into the chat box.
bedprotect.warn.vanilla: ⚠ Beds are allowed and protection is off — they explode like in vanilla!
bedprotect.hud.disabled: ✖ Bed blocked: it would explode here
bedprotect.hud.safe: ✔ Safe: you can blow it up
bedprotect.hud.lethal: ✖ Blocked: the blast would kill you
bedprotect.hud.fall: ✖ Blocked: the fall after the blast would kill you
bedprotect.hud.unprotected_lethal: ☠ Protection is off — this blast can kill you!
bedprotect.hud.fall_risk: ⚠ Fall of %2$s blocks: up to −%1$s more
bedprotect.hud.fall_lethal: ☠ A %s-block fall after the blast can kill you
bedprotect.hazard.deadly_drop: you can fall into lava or the void
bedprotect.check.normal: This bed does not explode here.
